audit_boundary.raw_events_scope: JSON parsed to select tool, thread and usage events. Agent messages retained only as UTF-8 hashes. Reasoning and analysis bodies discarded without inspection.

paired_benchmark.instrumentation_scope: Formatter-local top-level deepcopy arguments and json.dumps only. JSON byte sizes measure copy argument work, not physical allocated bytes. Separate tracemalloc call reports Python peak.
paired_benchmark.timing_scope: Sum of installed formatter call intervals; loop equivalence checks, guards and stdio are outside these intervals and inside total wall time.

cost_scope.preparation_scope: First recorded batch preparation through builds, projection, protocol checks, paired benchmark and freeze. Initial plan reading before this point is outside this wall-clock boundary.
cost_scope.usage_scope: Three original independent CLI turn.completed rows. Reasoning output stays a separate reported field.

limitations: Reviewer scope covers runtime metadata, cost accounting and identity checks.
Extra-model checks cover registered launch structure, retained CLI events and preparation records. Provider-internal attempts remain unexposed.
Current process enumeration supplements original retained-handle evidence. Unlogged historical processes remain unobserved.
Preparation child phases overlap the recorded total preparation window.
